logicalJson.rule: Recursively sort object keys using JavaScript UTF-16 lexical order; preserve array order; serialize with JSON.stringify semantics and no insignificant whitespace.

patchPolicy.add: target must be absent; array '-' append is allowed only when the parent is an array
patchPolicy.remove: target must exist and equal expectedBefore
patchPolicy.replace: target must exist and equal expectedBefore; after must differ
patchPolicy.childCandidate: must equal parent candidate after applying the repair patch exactly
patchPolicy.childChanges: must be semantically equivalent to the originating repair operations

lineagePolicy.childProposal: must bind the immediately previous proposal and its originating repair by id+logicalJsonSha256
lineagePolicy.runState: must contain the same contiguous lineage

artifactWritePolicy.create: target path must not already exist in the artifact store
artifactWritePolicy.modifyInitial: base artifact must exist and match baseSha256
artifactWritePolicy.modifyChild: base is the immediately preceding proposal candidate and baseSha256 must match its candidateStateHash

findingPolicy.repairFindingRefs: must resolve to AUTO_REPAIR findings in the exact validation report
findingPolicy.repairPathScope: for each cited finding, the operation target must be equal to or a descendant of at least one targetPaths scope declared by that finding
findingPolicy.sourceRef: repo-local source path before # must exist when the reference is repo-local

runStatePolicy.candidateHistoryRule: Exactly one ordered entry per committed proposal iteration. candidateSha256 is the logical hash of proposal.intent.candidate. Duplicate hashes are allowed and required to represent cycles.
runStatePolicy.cycleRule: CYCLE_DETECTED when the latest candidateSha256 equals any earlier candidateSha256; firstSeenIteration is the earliest prior iteration containing that same hash.
runStatePolicy.precedenceRule: Evaluate conditions in statePrecedence order and choose the first applicable state. REGRESSION, STALLED and MAX_ITERATIONS are evaluated only when the latest validation status is REJECT_FIXABLE.
runStatePolicy.stallFingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical sorted finding signatures {disposition,code,targetPaths}
runStatePolicy.stallRule: STALLED when the latest N consecutive REJECT_FIXABLE reports have the same fingerprint, where N=stallRepeatThreshold.
runStatePolicy.stalledRepeatCountRule: stalledEvidence.repeatCount must equal the maximal consecutive count of the current finding fingerprint ending at currentIteration.
runStatePolicy.regressionRule: REGRESSION when a post-repair REJECT_FIXABLE validation introduces any finding signature absent from the immediate repair-basis validation.
runStatePolicy.maxIterationsRule: MAX_ITERATIONS only when currentIteration reached maxIterations, latest status is REJECT_FIXABLE, and no higher-precedence terminal state applies.
runStatePolicy.repairChildAtomicity: A repair and its child proposal are one durable commit boundary. Before commit the visible state remains READY_TO_REPAIR with repair=null. After commit the parent iteration contains the repair and the immediately following child iteration exists with validationReport=null, yielding READY_TO_VALIDATE unless a higher-precedence terminal state applies. No durable snapshot may contain a persisted repair without its child proposal.

domainStateMapping.no report: READY_TO_VALIDATE unless SYSTEM_ERROR, AUTHORITY_CHANGED or CYCLE_DETECTED applies
domainStateMapping.REJECT_FIXABLE: REGRESSION, STALLED, MAX_ITERATIONS or READY_TO_REPAIR according to precedence

resolverDependencyPolicy.rule: The resolver entrypoint alone is insufficient provenance. Every required execution dependency must be present exactly once and its raw file SHA-256 must match before domain validation.
